data.long_description:
Provident Real Estate proudly presents this well-designed studio in Azizi Beach Oasis 1, Azizi Mirage, located in the heart of Dubai Studio City—one of Dubai’s fastest-growing residential and media production hubs.

Why It’s a Great Investment:

Rising demand for rentals due to nearby commercial hubs (Media City, Production City, Motor City).
Popular with young professionals seeking modern living and easy connectivity.
Strong ROI potential from 9.2% to 10% Gross, especially with lagoon-style communities gaining high rental premiums.

Property Details:

Studio Apartment
Fully Furnished (Branded and Good Quality Furnitures)
355.53 sq ft (approx.)
Beautiful Open Views
Ready to Move in
Current Asking Rent from AED 60k (ROI of 9.2% Gross)

Community Features:

Resort-style lagoon and sandy beach areas
Modern gym, pool & wellness amenities
Retail and F&B within the community
Quick access to Hessa Street & major highways

About Dubai Studio City:

Dubai Studio City is known for its vibrant community, home to leading media companies, modern residential developments, and excellent connectivity. The area offers a peaceful suburban feel while being just minutes away from key destinations. Its close proximity to Motor City provides quick access to supermarkets, schools, restaurants, fitness centers, and the popular Dubai Autodrome, making it highly attractive for both residents and investors.

A perfect opportunity for investors seeking high returns and long-term growth in a thriving community. Contact us today for more information.
